title: Moderates' political methods
subject: Polity
caption: Flowchart of the political methods employed by the Moderates
altText: A flowchart starting with identifying an issue, then drafting and submitting a petition. If the petition is accepted, it leads to reform; if not, a memorandum is drafted, submitted, and reviewed. Acceptance of the memorandum influences policy; otherwise a resolution is drafted, submitted, and debated. If the resolution passes, it is enacted; if it fails, constitutional agitation occurs, leading to public mobilization and a constitutional amendment.
